project_summary: Manufacturing execution system (MES) lite for shop-floor tracking and OEE dashboards

components.name: Shop-floor workstation API
components.description: Work order start/stop events, scrap reporting, and barcode scanning integration with PLC opc-ua bridge.

components.name: OEE calculation and dashboards
components.description: Availability, performance, and quality metrics aggregated per line/shift with Grafana embedding.

components.name: Production planning interface
components.description: Drag-and-drop schedule board synced from ERP work orders with conflict detection.

components.name: Preventive maintenance module
components.description: Asset registry, maintenance tickets, and spare parts inventory linked to work centers.
